انفأيت (form VII)
# اِنْفَأَيْتُ (infaʔaytu) /in.fa.ʔaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْفَأَى (infaʔā)
# اِنْفَأَيْتَ (infaʔayta) /in.fa.ʔaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْفَأَى (infaʔā)
# اِنْفَأَيْتِ (infaʔayti) /in.fa.ʔaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْفَأَى (infaʔā)
